culture.text: A 27-person software company founded in 2019 in Amsterdam, where many staff studied economics, econometrics or data science at VU or UvA.
Staff describe a young, international, hard-working team, and an intern says interns get trust, flexibility and ownership of their work.
It offers 25 days of vacation and says it pays a competitive salary.
